comment: The README says a .wav or .aif sample may be chosen, and mentions a retrigger mode on the right-click menu. Neither is in the installed 2.0.2: the loader is dr_wav, the previous and next buttons scan only .wav and .WAV files, and the menu holds Load Sample alone. The README's warning that some high-resolution and compressed files will not open is the maker's own and is kept.
